text:
infra-ci: FYI — at ~09:17 UTC we observed a rapid CrashLoop surge in the ml namespace on eu-west-3 after the nightly gitops post-sync. Several ml-worker pods started with missing MLFLOW_URI and ML_CACHE_DIR envs.

priya: deploy-bot shows the post-sync ran at 09:16:50 (commit ffe12b) and executed `kustomize build overlays/eu | kubectl apply -f -` as the final step.

deploy-bot: post-sync finished for infra/overlays/eu at 2026-11-05T09:16:50Z (commit ffe12b). Applied: 17, Deleted: 1.

kevin: quick diff — the sealedsecret resource in that commit contains an older ciphertext (legacy KMS alias). The release branch had the rotated ciphertext but the post-sync applied main-tip instead of the PR commit.

alex: reproducer: sealed-secrets operator reconciled the older encrypted payload and re-created the secret with blanked envs (operator filtered unknown keys), causing startup to fail healthchecks. Autoscaler reacted and added GPUs while pods flapped.

jordan: pod events snippet:
```
kubectl -n ml describe pod ml-worker-6c7d
Events:
  Warning  Unhealthy  30s (x6 over 4m)  kubelet  Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 500
  Normal   Killing    30s (x6 over 4m)  kubelet  Back-off restarting failed container
```

samantha: billing note — GPU node pool spiked for ~6 minutes. Finance estimated ~360 GPU-minutes extra, added to incident ticket.

priya: mitigation steps I ran:
```
# pause the gitops post-sync cron to avoid further overwrites
kubectl -n infra patch cronjob gitops-postsync --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/suspend","value":true}]'
# restore sealed secret from release branch
kubectl -n ml apply -f sealed/ml-worker-config.release-20261105.yaml
kubectl -n ml rollout restart deployment/ml-workers
```

infra-ci: pods recovered and became Ready in ~120s. Autoscaler scaled down extra nodes after ~5m.

kevin: proposed immediate actions:
- stop applying post-sync against the floating main tip; ensure we `git checkout $CI_COMMIT_SHA` before build/apply
- add a short mutex lock around sealed-secrets reconciler/apply window so the operator doesn't race
- add CI presubmit that attempts to decrypt sealedsecret and validate expected env keys present

alex: longer-term: upgrade sealed-secrets operator to v0.22+ for conflict detection, and add `gitops.postsync.commit` annotation to applied resources for traceability.

jordan: runbook + alerts:
- add alert: "ml namespace >3 pods CrashLoopBackOff in 5m"
- add cost alert: GPU pool exceeds 2x baseline
- update runbook: 'pause post-sync' + 'restore release sealedsecret' steps

priya: opened GH issue: https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/841 — "post-sync applying main-tip overwrites sealedsecret; causes ml-worker env loss". Hotfix PRs: pipeline pin commit, presubmit decrypt check, post-sync tagging.

ops-bot: incident created: INC-2026-1105-09 (severity: low-medium) — mitigated, follow-ups assigned.

kevin: owners: @kevin -> sealed-secrets upgrade & detection, @alex -> pipeline pin & annotations, @priya -> presubmit + hotfix, @jordan -> alerts/runbook.

infra-ci: status: mitigated. Follow-up work planned; monitoring for 24h canary.
